signature.composition: tag above broad funnel and buffer below
signature.cue: tag descends through funnel to buffer

prompt: One SQUARE flat icon on pure white for receiving PLC tag data into a local buffer. A large orange tag with a big white hole is ABOVE a broad BLUE FUNNEL whose wide open top receives it. The funnel neck leads into a dark navy rectangular buffer at the bottom. Clear white gaps keep the tag, funnel and buffer distinguishable. This is a funnel, NOT a tray, not a wireless symbol. Three large simple shapes, no text or shadows, generous white margins and recognizable at 30x18 pixels.
